svg.title: How it works
svg.desc: Your AI client talks MCP (stdio or Streamable HTTP) to safetyculture-mcp on your machine. The server checks the mode, masks personal data and wraps record text as untrusted, then calls the Mitti API with your token. A local SQLite cache feeds analytics, reports, dashboards and Power BI or Qlik exports.
